roles.harness: Claude Code 2.1.331, cloud session, main thread
roles.notes: Model and effort read from the session's own record (get_session, session_context.model and effort_level) at the start. This part wrote the brief, the hypotheses and the helper briefs, started the first seven helpers, and wrote the first schemas and checker modules. It stopped when the account hit its usage limit for this model.

roles.harness: Claude Code 2.1.331, cloud session, main thread
roles.notes: Same session. The owner switched the session's model after the usage limit. Model and effort read from the session's own record after the switch: session_context.model claude-opus-5-5, effort_level xhigh (last_served_model still showed the earlier model, from the turn before the switch). This part restarted the helpers, ran the scale runs, merged the stores and wrote the dossier.

roles.session: first-round limits helper (no session id shown)
roles.notes: A subagent inherits the parent's model; the error that stopped it named the model it was sent to (claude-fable-5-2). Its effort level was never read from its own session, so it is unknown. It stopped at the usage limit before writing notes; its sources (and for limits and identity, claims) were kept and continued by the restarted helper.
